items.english: It is in a dim light, and quiet like that light, three people drawing close with their heads together, telling a long story. The story seems to go on between them, so long and without ever breaking. And in that story everything in the world seems to be told — good and evil, sorrow and suffering and anger and trouble, joy, everything. But those who speak and those who listen only go on quietly, peacefully, still smiling, and they do not move at all. With heads bent and eyes lowered, only a quiet nostalgia and forgiveness seems to wrap them. And there too a deep, deep peace shows over all of them.
notes: Kept p16 in quiet present/continuing state where Japanese uses shiteiru forms, against past narration around it, per bible; did not mark vision as dream or heaven.
Rendered fukai-fukai as repeated 'deep, deep' to keep incantatory repetition rather than 'very deep'.

items.english: All things in the world, a life will pass. And only on the day it has passed will everything, all things, turn to nostalgia and forgiveness. And then they will be forever before a night-like rest.
notes: Kept speculative-future as future/gnomic 'will' and left 'they' unfused, so it can read as the three or as people in general.
Kept fixed phrase 'nostalgia and forgiveness' identical to p16 and 'rest' for an-soku.

items.english: The far picture lay dark and quiet in the bottom of her eyes. And through the bottom of her eyes, far into the future, with a lonely peace, that picture was still to be seen. Young, she gave alone a lonely secret sigh, and glancing at the littered table and at the faces of her husband and child, she stayed silent.
notes: Kept 'far', 'quiet', 'lonely', 'peace' as repetition network; returned to past tense for the return to the table.
Did not add psychology or identify the picture with family grown old; 'was still to be seen' keeps Japanese mieru impersonal.

data.say: Drafted the vision and its return in still present tense and plain repeated words.
